leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the cartilage caps was clear but less engaging because it was the only offered combination and the result was predictable.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt especially arbitrary; the pictures gave each part a recognizable purpose, although the later combinations were the only choices offered.
